newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS BANK RESULTS MEET MARKET EXPECTATIONS.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS BANK RESULTS MEET MARKET EXPECTATIONS.

text.p: The first quarter results released by Lithuania's Vilniaus Bank on Friday were in line with the market's expectations and should help to boost its share price, dealers said.
The bank announced that its Q1 net profit was 10.49 million litas versus 5.04 million litas for the same period last year.
"This is what the market expected...Hermis Bank's first quarter results were also good and people expected the same from Vilniaus Bank," said Tomas Andrejauskas of brokerage house Suprema.
"This result is not very surprising but it is good news," said another dealer.
"It should help increase its price," she added.
But dealers also cautioned against excessive optimism given the market's curious mood.
The market's response to Hermis Bank's first quarter results, which were also very good, was less than enthusiastic.
Hermis Bank has been easing but dealers say that it seems to have bottomed out and looks set to rise.
